{{Top|leg}}
The '''SR-09 reactor component''' was produced by [[Sirplex/Legends|Sirplex]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Designed for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Reactor/Legends|reactors]], the component boosted a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] maximum shield power by essentially adding a shield reserve onto the reactor.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{1st}}
